mapping.basis: Three execution equations of Primrec.ack, matched on the Nat constructors in source order: ack 0 n = Suc n; ack (Suc m) 0 = ack m 1; ack (Suc m) (Suc n) = ack m (ack (Suc m) n).
conditions: Nat.nat is the two-constructor datatype zero_nat/Suc.
Inner call ack (Suc m) n is evaluated before being passed to ack m _.

mapping.rust: pub fn suc(n: Nat) -> Nat { Nat::Suc(Box::new(n)) }
mapping.basis: Nat.Suc_def: Suc n = Abs_Nat (Suc_Rep (Rep_Nat n)); realized by the suc constructor helper wrapping the predecessor in the Suc variant.
conditions: Payload owns its inner Nat via Box to keep the enum sized.

mapping.basis: zero_nat is the nullary constructor of Nat.nat.
conditions: Used as the zero_nat constructor, not a machine 0.
